result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide roadway with four travel lanes creates a significant crossing distance. The environment lacks physical buffers like street trees or a median refuge, which increases pedestrian exposure to traffic in a commercial area.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation such as trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the moving traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area adjacent to the brick building.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical buffer and create vertical friction to naturally slow traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk. However, the pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the wide roadway lacks modern safety features like curb extensions or high-visibility pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway which can affect vehicle control and pedestrian stability.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground of the image across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded roadway surface to improve safety and accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing faded markings to high-visibility continental style to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. However, the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, and parked cars near the intersection may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a central refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main thoroughfare at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can hide pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes adjacent to the crosswalk markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extending the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: A raised island in the center of the street to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals in a residential setting.
